source_title: MEK inhibitors for neurofibromatosis type 1 manifestations: Clinical evidence and consensus
claim_text: In the NF106 phase 2 trial of mirdametinib in adolescents and adults with NF1 plexiform neurofibromas, tumor pain intensity decreased within the first 4 months of therapy and remained decreased through 12 months in participants whose tumors responded.
